items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was Rudy Williams. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Rudy, that's right.

ctx.x: And so we went in with this particular night, whatever night it was, we opened up with Lucky's band and so I told the cats, I said, look, man, they tell me Lucky is one of the favorites around here. What I think we ought to do we'll just play it kind of cool. We'll play some stocks for about the first two sets, maybe three sets, because we'll just kind of lay low and whatever they do I said, we're not going to pay it too much attention, just let them go on and do what they're going to do.
